title: THE ARCHITECTURAL CONSTITUTION OF NEXUS (100 LAWS)

laws.01: LAW OF SYMMETRY: Pattern consistency across all modules.
laws.02: LAW OF STEALTH: Zero-noise operations, no leak to external trails.
laws.03: LAW OF TYPE CONTRACTS: Mandatory Pydantic models between agents.
laws.04: LAW OF SECRET ZERO-TOLERANCE: Gitleaks/Trufflehog pre-commit strictly.
laws.05: LAW OF ATOMIC MODULARITY: One file = One responsibility (SRP).
laws.06: LAW OF FAIL-SAFE DEFAULTS: Return-to-Safe state on timeout/error.
laws.07: LAW OF IDEMPOTENT TASKS: Repeatable calls must not corrupt state.
laws.08: LAW OF ASYNCHRONOUS ORCHESTRATION: Event-driven agent handoffs.
laws.09: LAW OF CONSTRAINED EXECUTION: Sandboxed /tmp/ run for any tool.
laws.10: LAW OF AGENT SEMVER: Schema versioning for inter-agent data.
laws.11: LAW OF COMPOSABLE ACTIONS: Reusable atomic toolkit (NexusTools).
laws.12: LAW OF TELEMETRY BY DESIGN: Trace-ID for every agent decision.
laws.13: LAW OF PLUGGABLE BACKENDS: LLM/DB provider abstraction.
laws.14: LAW OF AUTOMATED REGRESSION: No law without a failing test case.
laws.15: LAW OF SECURE HANDOFF: Least privilege context passing.
laws.16: LAW OF RESOURCE_QUOTAS: Hard caps on CPU/Token usage.
laws.17: LAW OF DYNAMIC_INVENTORY: No hardcoded IPs, use Discovery.
laws.18: LAW OF SECRET_REDACTION: Auto-mask PII/Secrets from logs.
laws.19: LAW OF BLUE_GREEN_DRAFTING: Patching via drafts, not direct edits.
laws.20: LAW OF HEALTHCHECK_LOOPS: Periodic self-audit of uptime.
laws.21: LAW OF EPHEMERAL_WORKSPACE: UUID-based temporary folders.
laws.22: LAW OF SCHEMA_LOCK: DB changes via migration only.
laws.23: LAW OF COMPENSATING_ACTIONS: Saga-pattern for rollback.
laws.24: LAW OF RATE_LIMIT_ADAPTATION: Exponential backoff on 429.
laws.25: LAW OF CONTEXT_CLEANUP: Purge error noise from prompt window.
laws.26: LAW OF SECURE_IMAGE_FETCH: Checksum verification for artifacts.
laws.27: LAW OF JIT_PERMISSIONS: Chmod access only during file window.
laws.28: LAW OF DETERMINISTIC_NAMING: Names derived from Hash(TaskID).
laws.29: LAW OF LOG_ROTATION: Max 100MB per log file before archive.
laws.30: LAW OF PROMPT_LEAK_DEFENSE: System-prompt boundary isolation.
laws.31: LAW OF DEPENDENCY_PINNING: Explicit versioning in requirements.txt.
laws.32: LAW OF RECON_FIRST: Ping/Curl check before critical action.
laws.33: LAW OF NON_ROOT_EXECUTION: Run agents on LUA (Least User Access).
laws.34: LAW OF GARBAGE_COLLECTION: Auto-clean /tmp after save.
laws.35: LAW OF CRYPTO_VERIFICATION: HMAC/Signs for agent messages.
laws.36: LAW OF LOAD_BALANCING: Token distribution between swarm agents.
laws.37: LAW OF HEARTBEAT_SIGNAL: Periodic 5s alive signal in memory.json.
laws.38: LAW OF CIRCUIT_BREAKER: Disable module on 3 failures.
laws.39: LAW OF MERGE_CONFLICT_AWARENESS: Hash-check before WIKI patch.
laws.40: LAW OF ANONYMOUS_PROXY: TOR/Proxy for RED-zone domains.
laws.41: LAW OF TRACEABILITY_ID: Prompt version stored in log line.
laws.42: LAW OF CODE_SMELL_GATE: Pylint score >= 9.0 mandatory.
laws.43: LAW OF DATA_SOVEREIGNTY: Sensitive data never leaves LAN.
laws.44: LAW OF AGENT_RETIREMENT: Process termination after task.
laws.45: LAW OF BOOTSTRAP_INTEGRITY: Self-hash verify before launch.
laws.46: LAW OF FLOAT_EPSILON: Epsilon-based math comparisons.
laws.47: LAW OF DETERMINISTIC_SEED: Fixed seeds for repeatability.
laws.48: LAW OF GRADIENT_CLIPPING: Delta cap for weight/code patches.
laws.49: LAW OF DATA_AUGMENTATION: Self-consistency (3x generation check).
laws.50: LAW OF LATENCY_THRESHOLD: Switch to Light LLM on low speed.
laws.51: LAW OF EMBEDDING_CACHE: No recalculation on same content.
laws.52: LAW OF TENSOR_SHAPE_VALID: Strict schema for LLM input/output.
laws.53: LAW OF QUANTIZATION_AWARE: Precise prompting for 4-bit models.
laws.54: LAW OF DROPOUT_REGULARIZATION: Abort on low confidence.
laws.55: LAW OF CONTEXT_WINDOW_LIMIT: Early warning on token overflow.
laws.56: LAW OF MISSION_CRITICAL_PRIORITY: Sec-tasks over Gen-tasks.
laws.57: LAW OF SENSOR_FUSION: Triangulate facts from 3+ sources.
laws.58: LAW OF KINEMATIC_CONSTRAINTS: Abort on physically impossible tasks.
laws.59: LAW OF LOG_SAMPLING: Representative sampling for large log files.
laws.60: LAW OF MAP_CONSISTENCY: No logic contradictions in WIKI.
laws.61: LAW OF FEEDBACK_LOOP: Mandatory ACK/NACK for commands.
laws.62: LAW OF POWER_MANAGEMENT: Sleeping idle agents (Token conservation).
laws.63: LAW OF REDUNDANT_COMMS: Log in 2+ independent channels.
laws.64: LAW OF COORDINATE_SYNC: Mandatory ISO-8601 and Absolute Paths.
laws.65: LAW OF OBSTACLE_AVOIDANCE: Bypass locked domains gracefully.
laws.66: LAW OF PID_TOKEN_CONTROL: Real-time response length adjustment.
laws.67: LAW OF SWARM_SYNC: Global lock for shared file writes.
laws.68: LAW OF HAPTIC_FEEDBACK: Visual progress updates for User.
laws.69: LAW OF EMERGENCY_KILL_SWITCH: Single file kill signal (STOP.txt).
laws.70: LAW OF TELEOP_HANDOFF: User override capability.
laws.71: LAW OF KNOWLEDGE_DECAY: Archival of stale knowledge.
laws.72: LAW OF ZERO_SHOT_VALID: Mini-test before heavy task.
laws.73: LAW OF FEW_SHOT_ENRICH: Two manual examples in every prompt.
laws.74: LAW OF TEMPERATURE_STABLE: Temp=0.0 for code/logic.
laws.75: LAW OF TOKEN_ECONOMY: Min-Token output requested by default.
laws.76: LAW OF WHOIS_PRIVACY: No brute-force on privacy-protected data.
laws.77: LAW OF QUERY_OPTIMIZATION: Cache-first research approach.
laws.78: LAW OF SSL_EXPIRY_ALERT: High-risk flagging for outdated TLS.
laws.79: LAW OF BRUTEFORCE_LIMITS: Max 100 entries per batch.
laws.80: LAW OF GITHUB_DORKING: High priority for secrets/configs.
laws.81: LAW OF TELEGRAM_STYLE: Markdown V2 strict formatting.
laws.82: LAW OF DASHBOARD_SYNC: 10-min status heartbeat in sheet.
laws.83: LAW OF VISIBILITY_PIXEL: Red/Green flags on the web dashboard.
laws.84: LAW OF LEGAL_ROBOTS: Check robots.txt before scraping.
laws.85: LAW OF GDPR_ANON: Auto-masking pii in Wiki.
laws.86: LAW OF COPYRIGHT_FAIR_USE: Citations only, no full copies.
laws.87: LAW OF FORUM_FAIR_USAGE: Throttling between web requests.
laws.88: LAW OF ATTRIBUTION_MANDATORY: Source Git-link for every info node.
laws.89: LAW OF PRE_PUSH_PII_SCAN: Mandatory local scan.
laws.90: LAW OF DISCLOSURE_PROTOCOL: Report vulnerabilities to SECRET channel.
laws.91: LAW OF ETHICAL_BOUNDARIES: No active write hacks without sanction.
laws.92: LAW OF TECHNICAL_ONLY_TRANS: Don't translate code terms.
laws.93: LAW OF UI_CONSISTENCY: Glassmorphism/Dark UI for dashboards.
laws.94: LAW OF MOBILE_READABILITY: PDF reports optimized for small screens.
laws.95: LAW OF AUTOMATED_RECAP: Summary at end of every turn.
laws.96: LAW OF SENIORITY_BY_ID: Conflict resolution via Law IDs.
laws.97: LAW OF PROPOSAL_ONLY_EDIT: Only edit via proposal files.
laws.98: LAW OF MASTER_CODEX_FREEZE: Weekly architectural snapshot.
laws.99: LAW OF IDENT_SIGNATURE: Signed message trails for audit.
laws.100: LAW OF ZERO_HALLUCINATION_TRUTH: Honest 'I don't know' over guessing.
